about: 판매입력·견적서·수주 특별단가 — 품목을 먼저 담고 거래처를 나중에 골라도 특별단가가 걸린다(49회차 — 예전엔 품목을 고를 때만 찾아 거래처를 나중에 고르면 안 걸렸다). 특별단가는 API 로 만들고 끝에 지운다(특별단가그룹 QA-FLOWSP → 품목 777 → 거래처 QA-CUST 를 영업단가그룹으로 — E040124 원본 모델). 전표는 저장하지 않는다. 견적서·수주는 특별단가를 아예 몰랐다(50회차). 단가적용순서설정에서 거래처별특별단가(품목별)을 켜고 시험한 뒤 되돌린다(51회차 — 설정이 꺼져 있으면 안 거는 것이 원본 규칙).

shots.name: 품목 먼저 → 거래처 → 특별단가 777
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/partners','/items','/special-prices/groups'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(async ([pa, it, gs]) => { const c = pa.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'), i = it.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'); sessionStorage.setItem('spPartner', c.id); sessionStorage.setItem('spPartnerGroup', c.salesPriceGroup || ''); let g = gs.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-FLOWSP'); if (!g) g = (await window.__api('POST', '/special-prices/groups', { code: 'QA-FLOWSP', name: 'QA 화면시험 특별단가' })).body; sessionStorage.setItem('spGroup', g.id); await window.__api('POST', '/special-prices/groups/' + g.id + '/partners', { targetId: c.id, sales: true, purchase: false }); const r = await window.__api('POST', '/special-prices', { groupId: g.id, itemId: i.id, unitPrice: 777, remark: 'QA 화면시험' }); sessionStorage.setItem('spId', r.body.id); return r.status })

js:window.__api('GET', '/price-order-settings?category=SALES').then((r) => { sessionStorage.setItem('poSaved', JSON.stringify(r.body)); return window.__api('PUT', '/price-order-settings', { category: 'SALES', settings: r.body.map((l) => (l.functionName === '거래처별특별단가(품목별)' ? { ...l, active: true } : l)) }) }).then((r) => r.status)
expect:(() => { const tr = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((t) => t.innerText.includes('QA-PROD')); return tr ? tr.querySelectorAll('input.text-right')[1].value : '' })() === '777'

shots.name: 수주 — 품목 먼저 → 매출처 → 777, 뒷정리
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status })); true

js:(async () => { const g = sessionStorage.getItem('spGroup'), pid = sessionStorage.getItem('spPartner'), keep = sessionStorage.getItem('spPartnerGroup'); await window.__api('DELETE', '/special-prices/' + sessionStorage.getItem('spId')); await window.__api('DELETE', '/special-prices/groups/' + g + '/partners/' + pid + '?tradeType=SALES'); const r = await window.__api('DELETE', '/special-prices/groups/' + g); if (keep) await window.__api('PATCH', '/partners/' + pid + '/price-group', { salesPriceGroup: keep }); return r.status })()
